name: Yujin
source:
A school doctor at Crobi Academy.

Especially obsessed with bones, he is a rather eccentric teacher who fell in love with Beatrice, the school's skeleton anatomy model.

His record states that he worked at a medical company before, but nobody wants to know the reaason why he became a school doctor.

Likes: Bones, Beatrice
Dislikes: Any other part of the human body that is not a bone

[From [url=http://nl.cheritz.com/en/game_info/characters]Nameless Official Site[/url]]
